Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 February 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Unless a Jedi here, may cause a character just 'hit' by Valance to be lost. Once per game, may deploy Cyborg Construct on Valance from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Beilert Valance (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Beilert Valance (Errata)]] (published 1 January 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Beilert Valance”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
